services.desc: The Commercial Fishing Users Group Committee was originally established in 2016 in order to "provide guidance and recommendations to the Port of Newport Board of Commissioners on issues related to the commercial fishing docks and international terminal, port services and policies". The committee was re-established in 2017 by Resolution 2017-03, and includes representatives from different sectors that are recommended to and approved by the Port Commission, each serving a four year term. This was an in-person meeting held at the OSU Extension Office, 1211 SE Bay Boulevard, in Newport. services.name: RV Parks
services.desc: Perched on the edge of the magnificent Pacific Ocean, Newport is a welcoming community with active fishing, tourism, scientific, and arts communities. It is home to Oregon’s largest fishing fleet, miles of sandy beaches and forested hiking trails, Oregon State University’s Hatfield Marine Science Center, the Oregon Coast Aquarium, and the West Coast home port of the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration. The Port of Newport's South Beach Marina and RV Park are located on the south side of the beautiful Yaquina Bay shaded beneath the iconic Yaquina Bay Bridge.
